name: DeadBro

evidence.performance: C02: Rails APM is a primary job; request, SQL and queue timings (A01)
evidence.errors: E01: unhandled Rails exceptions captured and grouped automatically
evidence.uptime: U01, U04: HTTP website checks with content matching and a short stabilization delay
evidence.status: S01: public status page per website check, viewable without login
evidence.logs: L02: Growth+ log viewer browses lines by severity, linked to requests

line: Monitors Rails errors, requests, jobs, logs and website availability.
